message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake. Feel free to adjust quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or a splash of orange liqueur) to suit your taste. | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes | |------------|----------------------------------------|-------| | All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted; keep an eye on gluten development. | | Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process or natural cocoa. | | Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | Can substitute half with brown sugar for richer flavor. | | Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Helps the cake rise. | | Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for leavening. | | Salt | 1 tsp | Balances sweetness. | | Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion. | | Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Or use buttermilk for extra tenderness. | | Vegetable oil (or melted butter) | ½ cup (120 ml) | Oil keeps the cake moist; butter adds flavor. | | Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Pure vanilla for depth. | | Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Hot water dissolves cocoa and flour, creating a silky batter. | | Optional extras | | • 1 tsp espresso powder (enhances chocolate flavor)
• ¼ cup chocolate chips or chopped nuts (for texture)
• A splash of coffee or orange liqueur (for a twist) | **Basic Steps:** 1. Preheat your oven to 350 °F (175 °C). Grease and flour two 9‑inch round pans (or line with parchment). 2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. 3. Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla; beat on medium speed until smooth. 4. Stir in boiling water (batter will be thin—this is normal). 5. Pour evenly into prepared pans. 6. Bake 30–35 min, or until a toothpick comes out clean. 7. Cool in pans 10 min, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before frosting. Enjoy your chocolate cake!
